evidence_rule: Available requires native executable conformance at the audited commit. Source presence, a cross compile, or a dirty working tree does not qualify.

entries.evidence: zag-poc/VERSIONING.md marks ARM64 Linux experimental and cites qemu-user execution, while unsupported numeric, debug, and call cases remain and no physical ARM64 evidence is recorded.
entries.exit_gate: Pure Zag ARM64 ELF generation, ABI corpus, native device execution, self-hosting or documented bootstrap boundary, and cleanup pass.

entries.evidence: zag-poc/VERSIONING.md calls macOS not planned yet and requires a Mach-O backend.
entries.exit_gate: Mach-O x86-64 and ARM64 executables run natively on declared macOS versions with ABI and lifecycle conformance.

entries.evidence: zag-poc/VERSIONING.md calls Windows not planned and requires a PE/COFF backend.
entries.exit_gate: PE/COFF x86-64 and ARM64 executables run natively with Windows ABI, unwind, resource, and lifecycle conformance.

entries.evidence: No iOS target or native conformance suite exists at the pinned commit.
entries.exit_gate: Signed Zag executable code runs on physical iOS devices with lifecycle, ABI, and packaging conformance.

entries.evidence: No Android target or native conformance suite exists at the pinned commit.
entries.exit_gate: Zag ARM64 output runs on physical Android devices with ELF, JNI, lifecycle, and packaging conformance.

entries.evidence: No Objective C runtime ABI implementation or native conformance exists at the pinned commit.
entries.exit_gate: Typed Objective C message sends, callbacks, ownership, exceptions boundary, and aggregate cases pass on macOS and iOS devices.

entries.evidence: No COM ABI implementation or native conformance exists at the pinned commit.
entries.exit_gate: IUnknown lifetime, interface calls, callbacks, HRESULTs, threading model, and aggregate cases pass on Windows.

entries.evidence: No JNI ABI implementation or native conformance exists at the pinned commit.
entries.exit_gate: Java to Zag and Zag to Java calls, references, exceptions, threads, callbacks, and cleanup pass on Android devices.

entries.evidence: The pinned v2 ABI documents executable qsort evidence for one direct captureless scalar and pointer callback, while captures, returned callbacks, floats, aggregates, ownership, and unload contracts remain unsupported.
entries.exit_gate: Captureless and context callbacks across each supported platform ABI pass register, stack, lifetime, reentrancy, unwind boundary, and negative tests.

entries.evidence: No general foreign aggregate parameter and return ABI conformance exists at the pinned commit.
entries.exit_gate: Platform ABI suites pass small and large structs, unions, vectors, floats, alignment, return by value, and mixed register classes.

entries.evidence: The exact clean pinned commit defines compiler-owned #embed, source-relative identity, binary and empty resources, structured E0017 failures, foreground-cache byte identity, deterministic x86-64 execution, and qemu-user ARM64 execution through zag-poc/tests/run_resource_embed.sh. The clean tree also reached a byte-identical self-host fixpoint.
entries.exit_gate: Deterministic byte resources embed into every supported object format with identity, alignment, lookup, reproducibility, and malformed input tests.

entries.evidence: zag-poc/docs/DYNAMIC_SYSTEM_ABI.md proves a narrow x86-64 Linux dynamic ELF import path with scalar outbound calls and one captureless callback; other targets, aggregates, unload, TLS, and general callbacks are unsupported.
entries.exit_gate: Typed library loading, symbol lookup, version failure, ownership, unload, callback, and aggregate tests pass per supported platform.

entries.evidence: The pinned v2 concurrency guide documents bounded x86-64 atomics, futex wait and wake, and a direct join-only Linux worker slice; general arguments, detach, TLS, cross-platform workers, and a complete memory model remain unsupported.
entries.exit_gate: Public main-loop scheduling, wakeup, cancellation, worker pool, atomics, memory model, thread affinity, shutdown, and race tests pass on every target.

entries.evidence: zag.mod parsing and local dependency validation exist, but the language specification excludes package registry and dependency resolution semantics.
entries.exit_gate: Deterministic resolution, lockfile, checksums, offline mode, path dependencies, conflicts, cache ownership, and reproducible fetch tests pass.

entries.evidence: The pinned zagd architecture documents a checksummed incremental declaration index and background semantic rechecking, but not an in-process incremental parser or stable state-preserving library reload contract.
entries.exit_gate: Dependency invalidation, state preserving reload, ABI rejection, rollback, file race, crash recovery, and deterministic event hooks pass end to end.

entries.evidence: The exact clean pinned commit contains pure-Zag IEEE CRC32, Adler32, canonical stored-block zlib encode/decode, and bounded general stored/fixed/dynamic DEFLATE inflate. The 12-check primitive suite and 14-check inflater suite pass on x86-64; the same 14 checks pass in a Zag-generated ARM64 ELF under qemu-user, including independent Python-zlib fixtures, mixed blocks, every strict prefix, and single-bit mutations.
entries.exit_gate: Keep the focused checksum, stored-zlib, and cross-target general-inflate suites green at the exact Zag revision pinned by each Zagkit release.
